events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with potential for further conflict in the Middle East. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and global markets. The US and its allies are considering further action against Iran.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares Core S&P Total U.S. Stock Market ETF (ITOT)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to increased volatility in global markets, making it a good time to buy safe-haven assets or short the market. The US and its allies are considering further action against Iran, which could lead to further conflict and market volatility.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or when the market stabilizes
